title: A failing SpecSync change check may still record passed verification
symptom: One change check run exited 1 with an undocumented-export error, yet verification.json recorded passed true and status moved to verifying
trigger: First change check after adding a pub(crate) item in a new module
expected: A failing check records failed verification or none
actual: verification.json passed: true while the command failed
steps: Add a pub(crate) fn in src/stage.rs listed in the spec files
impact: Possible false verification evidence upstream; seen once and not reproduced
source: SpecSync rehearsal in a disposable clone, 2026-10-31

notes.text: 2026-10-31 independent reproduction (specsync 6.1.1, enforcement = strict): change check recorded passed true for specsync check --spec shipping (non-strict) with undocumented exports; check --commit then exited 1 on the effective-contract export errors without recording an attempt, and status kept next_action review. Cause in spec-sync f240d37: change_requires_strict_validation uses only built-in SpecSync paths and modules or --strict, never the project's enforcement setting, and the commit path validates more strictly than the recorded verification.
